aboutPage.lead: We're on a mission to make professional-grade electrical materials accessible to electricians, contractors, and DIY installers. Finding the right cables, switchgear, and installation accessories shouldn't be complicated.
aboutPage.value1Desc: Whether you're a professional electrician or a DIY installer, your satisfaction drives every decision we make.
aboutPage.value2Desc: We partner with trusted carriers to deliver your electrical supplies quickly and safely, every time.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Every product meets professional installation standards and is sourced from certified manufacturers.
aboutPage.value4Desc: We work directly with manufacturers to offer competitive trade prices on cables, switchgear, and more.
aboutPage.promiseText: We stand behind every electrical product we sell. If you're not completely satisfied, we'll make it right — that's our guarantee to you.

faqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about shopping with us
faqPage.a1: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping is available for 1-2 business day delivery. Free shipping is offered on orders over €100.
faqPage.a2: We offer a 14-day return policy on all items. Products must be unused and in their original packaging. Contact our support team to initiate a return.
faqPage.a3: Yes! We ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping typically takes 7-14 business days depending on the destination.
faqPage.q4: How can I track my order?
faqPage.a4: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. You can also track your order from your account dashboard.
faqPage.q5: What payment methods do you accept?
faqPage.a5: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and bank transfers. All payments are processed securely with SSL encryption.
faqPage.q6: Can I change or cancel my order?
faqPage.a6: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 1 hour of placement. After that, please contact our support team and we'll do our best to help.
faqPage.a7: Yes! Gift wrapping is available at checkout for a small additional fee. You can also include a personalized message with your gift.
faqPage.q8: How do I contact customer support?
faqPage.a8: You can reach us via our contact form, email at support@misaelectro.ro, or through live chat on our website. We're available 24/7 to help.
